applies_to: Individuals who have lost, damaged, or need to correct details on their existing citizenship certificate.
office: जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय (District Administration Office - DAO)
practical_tip: If the original certificate is lost, a police report (हराएको रिपोर्ट) is strictly required before the DAO will process a duplicate.

steps.action: File a police report (if the original is lost).
Submit the application form with required documents and fee.
Verification and issuance of the duplicate/corrected certificate.

documents.name: Original citizenship certificate (if damaged) OR Police report (if lost)
documents.reason: To establish the need for a duplicate

documents.name: Copy of father's or mother's citizenship certificate

extra_or_different_documents: Supporting documents proving the correct detail (e.g., birth certificate, academic transcripts)

time_needed: Same day to 3 days, depending on verification complexity.
legal_basis: नेपाल नागरिकता ऐन, २०६३ and नागरिकता नियमावली, २०६३

sources.title: नेपाली नागरिकताको सिफारिसका लागि आवश्यक कागजात र प्रक्रिया

flags: Exact fee may vary slightly between different District Administration Offices.

applies_to: Nepali citizens traveling abroad who need a new passport or renewal of an existing one.
office: राहदानी विभाग (Department of Passport) or designated DAO enrollment centers
online_note: Online pre-enrollment and form filling is mandatory at the Department of Passport website before visiting the center.
practical_tip: Ensure all details in the online form perfectly match your citizenship certificate. Errors require paying the fee again to re-apply.

steps.action: Complete the online passport application form and print it.
Obtain ward recommendation (if required for first-time applicants).
Submit documents, provide biometrics, and pay the fee at the Passport Office/DAO.
Collect the passport on the designated date.

documents.name: Original Nepali citizenship certificate and photocopy
National ID card
documents.reason: Mandatory for applicants aged 16 and above

documents.name: Old passport (for renewal cases)
documents.reason: To verify previous travel history and identity

extra_or_different_documents: Additional fee payment receipt (Rs. 10,000 or up to Rs. 15,000 for lost/damaged replacement)

fee: Rs. 5,000 (Regular), Rs. 10,000 (Urgent), up to Rs. 15,000 for lost/damaged replacement
time_needed: Regular: Several weeks. Urgent: Significantly faster (often within days).

sources.title: सेवा पुस्तिका - जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय, कास्की

flags: Some DAOs may waive the ward recommendation requirement for renewals, but first-time applicants generally still need it.

applies_to: Landowners needing an official copy of their land ownership document or a newly issued certificate.
online_note: Some offices allow online requests for copies via the 'Mero Kitta' portal, but physical verification is often still required.
practical_tip: Always bring the current fiscal year's property tax clearance receipt (मालपोत रसिद), as offices will reject applications without it.

steps.action: Obtain ward recommendation and current tax clearance receipt.
Submit application with documents at the Land Revenue Office.
steps.fee: Varies (nominal for copy, percentage-based for new)

steps.action: Verification and issuance of the certificate/copy.

documents.name: Current fiscal year property tax clearance receipt

extra_or_different_documents: Details of the original certificate (Kitta number, location)

fee: Nominal fee for a copy (e.g., Rs. 50-100). New issuance fees vary based on land value and transaction type.
time_needed: Same day for a simple copy request if records are digitized; longer for new issuances.
legal_basis: नापी ऐन and मालपोत सम्बन्धी नियमावली
flags: Fees and exact document requirements can vary slightly between different Land Revenue Offices.

applies_to: Individuals buying, inheriting, or receiving land as a gift, requiring official transfer of ownership.
practical_tip: Both the buyer and seller (or their legally authorized representatives with a registered power of attorney) must be physically present for biometric verification.

steps.action: Obtain ward recommendation and tax clearance for the property.
Draft and register the sale deed/agreement at the Land Revenue Office.
Biometric verification of both parties and issuance of the new ownership certificate.

documents.name: Citizenship certificates of both buyer and seller
Original land ownership certificate of the seller
Current fiscal year property tax clearance receipt

extra_or_different_documents: Death certificate of previous owner (for inheritance)

fee: Registration fee (typically around 1% of the transaction value or government-assessed value) + nominal administrative fees.
time_needed: Same day to a few days if all documents and parties are present.
legal_basis: नापी ऐन and मालपोत सम्बन्धी नियमावली
flags: Exact registration fee percentages are dictated by the annual Financial Act (आर्थिक ऐन) and may vary slightly by province.

applies_to: Individuals or entities planning to construct a new building or significantly renovate an existing one.
office: सम्बन्धित नगरपालिका वा गाउँपालिका (Municipality Engineering Section)
online_note: Some municipalities offer an electronic building map approval system (विद्युतीय भवन नक्सा पास प्रणाली) for initial submission.
practical_tip: Ensure your building design complies with the local municipality's building bylaws (e.g., setback rules, height limits) before submitting, as revisions cause significant delays.

steps.action: Prepare the building design/map with a registered engineer/architect.
Submit the application with the map, land documents, and tax clearance.
steps.fee: Varies by building size and estimated cost

steps.action: Municipal review, possible site inspection, and approval.
Issuance of the building permit (नक्सा पास प्रमाणपत्र).

documents.name: Approved building map/design (नक्सा) signed by a registered engineer
documents.reason: To verify compliance with building codes

documents.name: Current fiscal year property tax clearance receipt

fee: Varies significantly by municipality, often calculated as a percentage of the estimated construction cost or per square foot/meter.
time_needed: 7 to 15 days, depending on the complexity of the design and municipal workload.
legal_basis: स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालन ऐन, २०७४ and local municipal building bylaws

sources.title: आवश्यक कागजात तथा जनताले पुऱ्याउनु पर्ने प्रक्रिया

flags: Fees, processing times, and specific document requirements (e.g., soil test reports for large buildings) vary heavily between different municipalities.
